items.title: Referral codes can be brute forced or guessed to redeem against strangers' codes
Personal data exposed to unauthorised users
Server trusts the referral code and credit values sent by the client
Users can refer themselves because the two sides of the referral are never checked
Email-only sign-up lets anyone test whether a person already has an account
No link between a credited referral and the identity behind it, so fraud cannot be unwound
